procedures.source: Sling 2 Pilot Operating Handbook DC-POH-002-X-B-2.8 Revision 2.8: sections 4.5.1, 4.5.2, 4.5.3, 4.6, 4.7.1, 4.15, 4.16 and supplement 04/2012 (Rotax 912 iS) sections 9.4.12 and 9.4.13. Rotax 912 iS operator's manual not consulted (not obtainable); items it governs are marked.

items.note: Observe the temperature limits for engine start (POH 2.14).

items.response: on, verify EFIS on and back-up battery voltage
items.unverified: The back-up battery voltage limit is an original estimate; the POH asks only that the voltage be verified.
The back-up battery voltage limit is an original estimate; the POH asks only that the voltage be verified.

items.text: Lane A and Lane B warning lights
items.response: on for about 5 s, then out
items.note: Flashing, or not lighting, is a deficiency: do not take the engine into operation before it is rectified.
Start with the throttle at idle or at most 5% open, to avoid shock loading.
After a start attempt wait at least 2 minutes for the starter to cool.
Increase rpm only if oil pressure is steady above 3 bar (44 psi). With cold oil keep watching it: it can drop again.

limits.message: Increase rpm only once oil pressure is steady above 3 bar.

items.note: Supplement 9.4.12 item 14 allows one minute for the 912 iS; the longer figure of 4.5.3 is used here.
The supplement raises rpm to about 3,000 until the voltage shows alternator B online.

limits.message: Hold the engine to 2,500 rpm or less until the oil is at 50 C.

items.note: The propeller can suck up grit that damages the blade leading edges.
Do not run up a cold engine. If the oil is below 50 C keep warming it at 2,500 rpm.

items.unverified: The back-up battery voltage limit is an original estimate; the POH asks only that the voltage be verified.

items.note: Only one ignition circuit (lane) at a time. Switching lane B off leaves lane A running the engine.
items.unverified: 25 rpm allowance for measurement scatter is an original estimate; lane check detail per Rotax 912 iS operator's manual, not verified

items.note: An rpm drop of less than 180 rpm is permissible when lane A is switched off.
